punchline: Of 1,097 people who passed, seven stopped.
thirty_sec: On 12 January 2007 Joshua Bell played about 45 minutes in a Washington Metro station dressed as a street musician. According to the Washington Post, 1,097 people passed, seven stopped and he collected $32.17. The setting told people what to expect before the first note.
question: Which idea or person did you wave through recently because of the setting it arrived in?
key_contrast: Same music; the setting changed the listening.
